name: io.github.First-CH/tools-mcp
description: MCP tools: WCAG contrast, JP char/X-weight count, WebP convert, JSON-LD, llms.txt, encoding/line-ending convert, Marp Markdown→slides render, test data generation, text/code diff, cron expression explain, Base64/data-URI encode & decode, URL query-parameter parse/edit/rebuild with UTM tagging, HTML entity escape & unescape, px ⇄ rem/em unit conversion with bulk CSS rewriting, HEX/RGB/HSL/OKLCH colour conversion with alpha compositing, MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-384/SHA-512 hashing with checksum verification, JWT decode with expiry check and signature verification, User-Agent parsing with browser/engine/OS/device and bot detection, bulk UUID v4 / ULID generation, aspect-ratio calculation with responsive sizing and CSS aspect-ratio snippets, Markdown table formatting with TSV/CSV conversion, SQL query formatting (uppercase keywords, a line break per clause, indented subqueries), QR code generation from a URL or text (SVG / PNG / text art, error correction L-H), Unix timestamp ⇄ ISO 8601 / local-time conversion with time zones and relative readings, robots.txt generation with crawl rules, sitemap declarations and presets for AI crawlers, case conversion between camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, CONSTANT_CASE, kebab-case and six more, in bulk or per CSV field, CSV/TSV ⇄ JSON conversion with delimiter detection and nested a.b columns, full-width ⇄ half-width conversion for Japanese text with per-character-kind directions, half-width katakana composing/splitting and whitespace cleanup, and IP/CIDR calculation (network, broadcast, host range and counts for IPv4/IPv6, subnet splitting, membership checks and reducing an IP range to the smallest CIDR set), and business-day date calculation (days and business days between two dates, the due date N days or N business days from a start date, and payment dates from a closing day, with weekends and Japan's public holidays built in), and HTML-to-Markdown conversion (headings, lists, tables, links, images and code blocks, with script/style and presentational tags removed, main-content extraction and relative URLs resolved against a base URL), and Japanese era ⇄ Western date conversion (Reiwa to Meiji, auto-detected, weekday and zodiac, non-existent era dates flagged, age and school entry years from a date of birth, era list and year chart), and URL-slug generation from Japanese titles (kana to Hepburn romaji, symbols removed, hyphen/underscore joined, lowercased), and htpasswd generation for HTTP Basic auth (bcrypt / apr1-md5 lines, random passwords for empty entries, Apache / nginx config snippets and verification of existing hashes), and OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 (YAML or JSON) to a Japanese or English Markdown API reference and TypeScript type definitions (per-endpoint params/request/response types, $ref/allOf/oneOf, external $refs never fetched), and FAQ structured data (FAQPage JSON-LD plus the same Q&A as Markdown and details/summary HTML, with answers' links and lists turned into HTML and pasted "Q: / A:" text split into pairs), and line operations on text (removing duplicate lines, number-aware sorting, seeded shuffling, line numbers, blank-line removal, trimming and prefixes/suffixes), and print size / DPI calculation (pixels needed for a paper size at a resolution with bleed, effective dpi of an existing image with a verdict, quick-reference tables and mm/inch/px/pt/Q conversion), and SERP snippet checks (whether a title and meta description fit a Google result by pixel width, with the visible lines, the cut-off part, the breadcrumb and checks for https, path depth and missing site names), and Flexbox / CSS Grid CSS generation (only non-default declarations, repeated tracks folded into repeat(), grid-template-areas validated for rectangles and equal rows, and notes on combinations that do nothing). Also app_* tools that call the JSON APIs of the 33 web apps at apps.first-ch.com (GEO/AI-search readiness, meta tags, security headers, SSL certificates, DNS and email DNS, redirects, broken links, structured data, AI-crawler access, sitemap, hreflang, Japanese readability, business-tone and LP-copy checks and more); unlike the local tools, these send their input to apps.first-ch.com, so they are off by default and enabled with FIRSTCH_ENABLE_APPS=1.

environmentVariables.name: FIRSTCH_TOOLS_USAGE_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to a local JSONL file for opt-in usage logging. No logging when unset.

environmentVariables.name: FIRSTCH_APPS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Base URL for the app_* tools (default https://apps.first-ch.com). For testing only.

environmentVariables.name: MARP_CHROME_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to a Chrome/Chromium executable used by marp_render for PDF output. Auto-detected on common paths when unset; PDF is skipped (HTML still returned) if none is found.
